+        *,
+        confirmed: bool = True,
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot | None:
+        """Cover a positive, broker-confirmed cumulative entry fill."""
+
+        cycle = _text(cycle_id, "cycle_id")
+        quantity = _decimal(cumulative_filled_qty, "cumulative_filled_qty")
+        price = _decimal(avg_fill_price, "avg_fill_price", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(confirmed, bool):
+            raise TypeError("confirmed must be bool")
+        if not confirmed or quantity == _ZERO:
+            return self.current_protection(cycle)
+
+        state = self._cycles.setdefault(cycle, _CycleState(cycle_id=cycle))
+        if quantity < state.confirmed_entry_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("cumulative_filled_qty must not decrease")
+        state.confirmed_entry_quantity = quantity
+        state.avg_fill_price = price
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+
+        if state.working_exit is not None or state.pending_exit_quantity > _ZERO:
+            return self._snapshot(state)
+        if state.protective_order_id is None:
+            await self._place_protection(state)
+        elif state.working_protective_quantity != state.remaining_quantity:
+            await self._request_replacement(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    async def on_exit_requested(
+        self, cycle_id: str, qty: Decimal, reason: str
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        """Queue or submit an exit without overlapping an effective stop."""
+
+        state = self._require_cycle(cycle_id)
+        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
+        exit_reason = _text(reason, "reason")
+        if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("cannot exit a cycle with no confirmed remaining position")
+        if state.working_exit is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("an exit order is already working for this cycle")
+        requested = state.pending_exit_quantity + quantity
+        if requested > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("requested exit quantity exceeds confirmed remaining quantity")
+
+        state.pending_exit_quantity = requested
+        state.pending_exit_reason = exit_reason
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            if state.status != "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_EXIT":
+                state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_EXIT"
+                await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)
+        else:
+            await self._release_pending_exit(state)
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    async def on_broker_order_update(
+        self,
+        cycle_id: str,
+        order_id: str,
+        status: object,
+        *,
+        filled_qty: Decimal = _ZERO,
+        avg_fill_price: Decimal | None = None,
+        occurred_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        """Apply a normalized cumulative broker-order update."""
+
+        state = self._require_cycle(cycle_id)
+        broker_order_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        normalized = _status(status)
+        cumulative = _decimal(filled_qty, "filled_qty")
+        if avg_fill_price is not None:
+            _decimal(avg_fill_price, "avg_fill_price", positive=True)
+        state.updated_at = self._now() if occurred_at is None else _utc(occurred_at, "occurred_at")
+
+        if broker_order_id == state.protective_order_id:
+            await self._apply_protective_update(state, normalized, cumulative)
+        elif state.working_exit is not None and broker_order_id == state.working_exit.order_id:
+            await self._apply_exit_update(state, normalized, cumulative)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("order update does not belong to an effective order for this cycle")
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    def current_protection(self, cycle_id: str) -> _ProtectionSnapshot | None:
+        state = self._cycles.get(_text(cycle_id, "cycle_id"))
+        return None if state is None else self._snapshot(state)
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        return _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock.now()")
+
+    def _require_cycle(self, cycle_id: str) -> _CycleState:
+        cycle = _text(cycle_id, "cycle_id")
+        try:
+            return self._cycles[cycle]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown PositionCycle id: {cycle}") from None
+
+    async def _broker_call(self, preferred: str, fallback: str, request: object) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._broker, preferred, None)
+        if not callable(method):
+            method = getattr(self._broker, fallback, None)
+        if not callable(method):
+            raise TypeError(f"broker must provide {preferred}() or {fallback}()")
+        return await _await_if_needed(method(request))
+
+    async def _place_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        if state.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+            return
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("cannot place a second effective protective order")
+        if state.avg_fill_price is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("confirmed average fill price is required for protection")
+        request = _ProtectiveOrderRequest(
+            cycle_id=state.cycle_id,
+            quantity=state.remaining_quantity,
+            confirmed_avg_fill_price=state.avg_fill_price,
+            policy=self._policy,
+            created_at=self._now(),
+        )
+        try:
+            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call(
+                "submit_protective_order", "submit_order", request
+            )
+            state.protective_order_id = _order_id(acknowledgement)
+            state.protective_order_quantity = state.remaining_quantity
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            state.status = "PROTECTION_ACTIVE"
+            state.last_error = None
+            self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective placement failed: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+
+    async def _request_replacement(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        if state.protective_order_id is None:
+            await self._place_protection(state)
+            return
+        if state.status == "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT":
+            return
+        state.pending_replacement = True
+        state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT"
+        await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)
+
+    async def _cancel_effective_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        order_id = state.protective_order_id
+        if order_id is None:
+            return
+        cancel = getattr(self._broker, "cancel_order", None)
+        if not callable(cancel):
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, "broker must provide cancel_order()")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error)
+        try:
+            await _await_if_needed(cancel(order_id))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective cancellation failed: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+
+    async def _release_pending_exit(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        quantity = state.pending_exit_quantity
+        if quantity == _ZERO:
+            return
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("cannot release exit while protection remains effective")
+        if quantity > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise RuntimeError("pending exit exceeds confirmed remaining position")
+        reason = state.pending_exit_reason
+        assert reason is not None
+        request = _ExitOrderRequest(state.cycle_id, quantity, reason, self._now())
+        try:
+            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call("submit_exit_order", "submit_order", request)
+            state.working_exit = _WorkingExit(_order_id(acknowledgement), quantity)
+            state.pending_exit_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.pending_exit_reason = None
+            state.status = "EXIT_ACTIVE"
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"exit placement failed after protection cancel: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+
+    async def _apply_protective_update(
+        self, state: _CycleState, status: str, cumulative_filled: Decimal
+    ) -> None:
+        if cumulative_filled < state.protective_cumulative_filled:
+            raise ValueError("protective cumulative filled quantity must not decrease")
+        if cumulative_filled > state.protective_order_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("protective filled quantity exceeds its order quantity")
+        state.protective_cumulative_filled = cumulative_filled
+
+        if status in {"PARTIALLY_FILLED", "PARTIAL_FILL"}:
+            state.status = "PROTECTION_PARTIALLY_FILLED"
+            return
+        if status == "FILLED":
+            state.confirmed_exit_quantity += state.protective_cumulative_filled
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            state.status = "POSITION_CLOSED" if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO else "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+            if state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                self._mark_unprotected(state, "protective order filled without closing position")
+            else:
+                self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+            return
+        if status in {"CANCELED", "CANCELLED"}:
+            replace_after_cancel = state.pending_replacement
+            state.confirmed_exit_quantity += state.protective_cumulative_filled
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            if state.pending_exit_quantity > _ZERO:
+                await self._release_pending_exit(state)
+            elif replace_after_cancel and state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                await self._place_protection(state)
+            elif state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                self._mark_unprotected(state, "protective order canceled without replacement")
+            return
+        if status in {"REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}:
+            state.confirmed_exit_quantity += state.protective_cumulative_filled
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective order became {status}")
+            return
+        if status not in _TERMINAL:
+            # ACCEPTED/PENDING/NEW updates preserve the currently effective order.
+            return
+
+    async def _apply_exit_update(
+        self, state: _CycleState, status: str, cumulative_filled: Decimal
+    ) -> None:
+        working = state.working_exit
+        assert working is not None
+        if cumulative_filled < working.cumulative_filled:
+            raise ValueError("exit cumulative filled quantity must not decrease")
+        if cumulative_filled > working.quantity:
+            raise ValueError("exit filled quantity exceeds its order quantity")
+        delta = cumulative_filled - working.cumulative_filled
+        working.cumulative_filled = cumulative_filled
+        state.confirmed_exit_quantity += delta
+
+        if status in {"PARTIALLY_FILLED", "PARTIAL_FILL"}:
+            state.status = "EXIT_PARTIALLY_FILLED"
+            return
+        if status in _TERMINAL:
+            state.working_exit = None
+            if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO:
+                state.status = "POSITION_CLOSED"
+                self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+            else:
+                await self._place_protection(state)
+
+    def _mark_unprotected(self, state: _CycleState, message: str) -> None:
+        state.status = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+        state.last_error = message
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+        self._unprotected_cycles.add(state.cycle_id)
+
+    def _assert_sell_invariant(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        working = state.working_protective_quantity + state.working_exit_quantity
+        if working > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "working protective plus exit quantity exceeds confirmed remaining long quantity"
+            )
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None and state.working_exit is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("protective and discretionary sell orders must not overlap")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _snapshot(state: _CycleState) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        return _ProtectionSnapshot(
+            cycle_id=state.cycle_id,
+            status=state.status,
+            confirmed_remaining_quantity=state.remaining_quantity,
+            protective_order_id=state.protective_order_id,
+            protective_working_quantity=state.working_protective_quantity,
+            exit_order_id=None if state.working_exit is None else state.working_exit.order_id,
+            exit_working_quantity=state.working_exit_quantity,
+            pending_replacement=state.pending_replacement,
+            pending_exit_quantity=state.pending_exit_quantity,
+            updated_at=state.updated_at,
+            last_error=state.last_error,
+        )

+"""Provider-neutral protective-order policy and capability evaluation.
+
+Capability declarations are intentionally explicit and default to unsupported.
+An adapter must advertise both support and, for LIVE execution, the combinations
+that have already been demonstrated in PAPER.  This keeps an unknown provider
+combination from becoming an implicit live-trading experiment.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Iterable
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import OrderType, TimeInForce
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+__all__ = [
+    "ProtectionMode",
+    "ProtectionPolicy",
+    "BrokerProtectionCapabilities",
+    "ProtectionEligibility",
+    "evaluate_policy",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_STOP_MARKET = "STOP_MARKET"
+_STOP_LIMIT = "STOP_LIMIT"
+_TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
+_TRAIL_PRICE = "TRAIL_PRICE"
+_TRAIL_PERCENT = "TRAIL_PERCENT"
+_ALLOWED = "ALLOWED"
+_REJECTED = "REJECTED"
+
+_RISK_NOTES = (
+    "A stop trigger price is not a guaranteed execution price or maximum loss.",
+    "A stop-limit order may not fill.",
+    "DAY TIF expires and leaves an overnight residual unless protection is renewed.",
+)
+
+
+class ProtectionMode(StrEnum):
+    FIXED = "FIXED"
+    TRAILING_NATIVE = "TRAILING_NATIVE"
+    TRAILING_STEPPED = "TRAILING_STEPPED"
+
+
+def _positive_decimal(value: object, name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite positive Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+def _order_semantics(value: object) -> str:
+    raw = value.value if isinstance(value, OrderType) else value
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        raise TypeError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
+    normalized = raw.strip().upper()
+    if normalized == OrderType.STOP.value:
+        normalized = _STOP_MARKET
+    if normalized not in {_STOP_MARKET, _STOP_LIMIT}:
+        raise ValueError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _tif(value: object) -> TimeInForce:
+    if isinstance(value, TimeInForce):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return TimeInForce(value.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError("time_in_force must be DAY or GTC")
+
+
+def _mode_value(value: object) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw.upper() not in {item.value for item in ExecutionMode}:
+        raise ValueError("execution_mode must be BACKTEST, SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
+    return raw.upper()
+
+
+def _normalize_order_types(values: Iterable[object], name: str) -> frozenset[str]:
+    try:
+        normalized: set[str] = set()
+        for value in values:
+            raw = value.value if isinstance(value, OrderType) else value
+            if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip().upper() == _TRAILING_STOP:
+                normalized.add(_TRAILING_STOP)
+            else:
+                normalized.add(_order_semantics(value))
+        return frozenset(normalized)
+    except TypeError as exc:
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an iterable of order types") from exc
+
+
+def _normalize_tifs(values: Iterable[object], name: str) -> frozenset[TimeInForce]:
+    try:
+        return frozenset(_tif(value) for value in values)
+    except TypeError as exc:
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an iterable of TIF values") from exc
+
+
+def _normalize_combinations(
+    values: Iterable[tuple[object, object]], name: str
+) -> frozenset[tuple[str, TimeInForce]]:
+    result: set[tuple[str, TimeInForce]] = set()
+    try:
+        for order_type, tif in values:
+            normalized = _normalize_order_types((order_type,), name)
+            result.add((next(iter(normalized)), _tif(tif)))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise type(exc)(f"invalid {name}: {exc}") from exc
+    return frozenset(result)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ProtectionPolicy:
+    """One long-position protection rule.
+
+    ``fixed_reference`` is a provider-neutral reference name.  The default is
+    the broker-confirmed average fill; configured systems may use another
+    documented reference and resolve it before broker submission.
+    """
+
+    mode: ProtectionMode
+    required: bool = True
+    order_semantics: str | OrderType = _STOP_MARKET
+    limit_offset: Decimal | None = None
+    fixed_reference: str = "CONFIRMED_FILL_PRICE"
+    distance_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    distance_usd: Decimal | None = None
+    atr_multiple: Decimal | None = None
+    support_level: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
+    time_in_force: TimeInForce | str = TimeInForce.GTC
+    allow_fractional_protection: bool = False
+    documented_fractional_risk_ack: str | None = None
+    linked: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.mode, ProtectionMode):
+            try:
+                object.__setattr__(self, "mode", ProtectionMode(str(self.mode).upper()))
+            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise ValueError("mode must be a ProtectionMode") from exc
+        for name in ("required", "allow_fractional_protection", "linked"):
+            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), bool):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be bool")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "order_semantics", _order_semantics(self.order_semantics))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "time_in_force", _tif(self.time_in_force))
+        if not isinstance(self.fixed_reference, str) or not self.fixed_reference.strip():
+            raise ValueError("fixed_reference must be a non-empty string")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "fixed_reference", self.fixed_reference.strip().upper())
+
+        for name in (
+            "limit_offset",
+            "distance_percent",
+            "distance_usd",
+            "atr_multiple",
+            "support_level",
+            "trail_percent",
+            "trail_price",
+        ):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _positive_decimal(getattr(self, name), name))
+
+        if self.order_semantics == _STOP_LIMIT and self.limit_offset is None:
+            raise ValueError("STOP_LIMIT requires limit_offset")
+        if self.order_semantics == _STOP_MARKET and self.limit_offset is not None:
+            raise ValueError("STOP_MARKET does not accept limit_offset")
+
+        fixed_count = sum(
+            value is not None
+            for value in (
+                self.distance_percent,
+                self.distance_usd,
+                self.atr_multiple,
+                self.support_level,
+            )
+        )
+        trail_count = int(self.trail_percent is not None) + int(self.trail_price is not None)
+        if self.mode is ProtectionMode.FIXED:
+            if fixed_count != 1:
+                raise ValueError("FIXED requires exactly one distance definition")
+            if trail_count:
+                raise ValueError("FIXED does not accept native trailing distances")
+        elif self.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+            if trail_count != 1:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "TRAILING_NATIVE requires exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent"
+                )
+            if fixed_count:
+                raise ValueError("TRAILING_NATIVE does not accept fixed distances")
+
+        ack = self.documented_fractional_risk_ack
+        if ack is not None:
+            if not isinstance(ack, str) or not ack.strip():
+                raise ValueError("documented_fractional_risk_ack must be non-empty when set")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "documented_fractional_risk_ack", ack.strip())
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BrokerProtectionCapabilities:
+    """Explicit supported and paper-proven protective-order combinations."""
+
+    supported_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    standalone_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+    fractional_combinations: frozenset[tuple[str | OrderType, TimeInForce | str]] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+    paper_proven_fractional_combinations: frozenset[
+        tuple[str | OrderType, TimeInForce | str]
+    ] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    supported_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+    linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in (
+            "supported_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_order_types",
+            "fractional_combinations",
+            "paper_proven_fractional_combinations",
+            "supported_tifs",
+            "paper_proven_tifs",
+            "linked_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_linked_order_types",
+            "standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "linked_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters",
+        ):
+            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), frozenset):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a frozenset")
+
+        for name in (
+            "supported_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_order_types",
+            "linked_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_linked_order_types",
+        ):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_order_types(getattr(self, name), name))
+        for name in ("supported_tifs", "paper_proven_tifs"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_tifs(getattr(self, name), name))
+        for name in ("fractional_combinations", "paper_proven_fractional_combinations"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_combinations(getattr(self, name), name))
+        for name in (
+            "standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "linked_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters",
+        ):
+            normalized = frozenset(str(value).strip().upper() for value in getattr(self, name))
+            if not normalized <= {_TRAIL_PRICE, _TRAIL_PERCENT}:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} contains an unsupported trailing parameter")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, normalized)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ProtectionEligibility:
+    status: str
+    reason_code: str | None
+    risk_notes: tuple[str, ...]
+    entry_allowed: bool
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.status not in {_ALLOWED, _REJECTED}:
+            raise ValueError("status must be ALLOWED or REJECTED")
+        if (self.reason_code is None) != (self.status == _ALLOWED):
+            raise ValueError("REJECTED requires a reason code; ALLOWED must not have one")
+
+    @property
+    def allowed(self) -> bool:
+        return self.status == _ALLOWED
+
+    @property
+    def rejected(self) -> bool:
+        return self.status == _REJECTED
+
+
+def _result(policy: ProtectionPolicy, reason: str | None = None) -> ProtectionEligibility:
+    allowed = reason is None
+    return ProtectionEligibility(
+        status=_ALLOWED if allowed else _REJECTED,
+        reason_code=reason,
+        risk_notes=_RISK_NOTES,
+        entry_allowed=allowed or not policy.required,
+    )
+
+
+def evaluate_policy(
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | object,
+    quantity: Decimal,
+) -> ProtectionEligibility:
+    """Return a deterministic, fail-closed capability decision."""
+
+    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+        raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+    if not isinstance(capabilities, BrokerProtectionCapabilities):
+        raise TypeError("capabilities must be BrokerProtectionCapabilities")
+    if not isinstance(quantity, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("quantity must be Decimal")
+    if not quantity.is_finite() or quantity <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("quantity must be a finite positive Decimal")
+    live = _mode_value(execution_mode) == ExecutionMode.LIVE.value
+
+    if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_STEPPED:
+        return _result(policy, "STEPPED_NOT_AVAILABLE")
+    if policy.mode not in {ProtectionMode.FIXED, ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE}:
+        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_MODE")
+
+    order_type = (
+        _TRAILING_STOP
+        if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE
+        else str(policy.order_semantics)
+    )
+    tif = policy.time_in_force
+    assert isinstance(tif, TimeInForce)
+
+    if order_type not in capabilities.supported_order_types:
+        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+    if live and order_type not in capabilities.paper_proven_order_types:
+        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+
+    if tif not in capabilities.supported_tifs:
+        return _result(policy, "TIF_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+    if live and tif not in capabilities.paper_proven_tifs:
+        return _result(policy, "TIF_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+
+    trail_parameter: str | None = None
+    if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+        trail_parameter = _TRAIL_PRICE if policy.trail_price is not None else _TRAIL_PERCENT
+        if trail_parameter not in capabilities.standalone_trailing_parameters:
+            return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+        if live and trail_parameter not in capabilities.paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters:
+            return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+
+    if policy.linked:
+        if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+            if trail_parameter not in capabilities.linked_trailing_parameters:
+                return _result(policy, "LINKED_TRAILING_UNSUPPORTED")
+            if live and trail_parameter not in capabilities.paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters:
+                return _result(policy, "LINKED_TRAILING_UNSUPPORTED")
+        else:
+            if order_type not in capabilities.linked_order_types:
+                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+            if live and order_type not in capabilities.paper_proven_linked_order_types:
+                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+
+    fractional = quantity != quantity.to_integral_value()
+    if fractional:
+        if (
+            not policy.allow_fractional_protection
+            or policy.documented_fractional_risk_ack is None
+        ):
+            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+        combination = (order_type, tif)
+        if combination not in capabilities.fractional_combinations:
+            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+        if live and combination not in capabilities.paper_proven_fractional_combinations:
+            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_PAPER_PROVEN")
+
+    return _result(policy)

+class FakeBroker:
+    def __init__(self, *, fail_protection: bool = False) -> None:

+        self.protective_requests = []
+        self.exit_requests = []
+        self.cancel_requests = []
+        self.events = []
+        self._next = 0

+    def submit_protective_order(self, request):
+        if self.fail_protection:
+            raise RuntimeError("provider rejected stop")
+        self._next += 1
+        order_id = f"p-{self._next}"
+        self.protective_requests.append(request)
+        self.events.append(("protect", order_id, request.quantity))
+        return order_id

+    def submit_exit_order(self, request):
+        self._next += 1
+        order_id = f"e-{self._next}"
+        self.exit_requests.append(request)
+        self.events.append(("exit", order_id, request.quantity))
+        return order_id
+
+    def cancel_order(self, order_id):
+        self.cancel_requests.append(order_id)
+        self.events.append(("cancel", order_id))

+"""Central coordination of broker-held protection and discretionary exits.
+
+The coordinator is deliberately independent of strategy scheduling and control
+state.  Its only inputs are confirmed broker quantities/order updates, policy,
+capabilities, a broker port, and a UTC clock.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import inspect
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any, Protocol
+
+from mike_trade.runtime import ClockPort, ExecutionMode
+
+from .stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionEligibility,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+    evaluate_policy,
+)
+
+__all__ = ["ProtectionCoordinator"]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TERMINAL = frozenset({"CANCELED", "CANCELLED", "FILLED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"})
+
+
+class _ProtectionBrokerPort(Protocol):
+    """Minimal provider-neutral surface used by this coordinator.
+
+    A concrete adapter may implement ``submit_protective_order`` and
+    ``submit_exit_order`` directly, or accept both request values through its
+    generic ``submit_order`` method.
+    """
+
+    def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> object: ...
+
+    def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> object: ...
+
+    def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> object: ...
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _ProtectiveOrderRequest:
+    cycle_id: str
+    quantity: Decimal
+    confirmed_avg_fill_price: Decimal
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy
+    created_at: datetime
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _ExitOrderRequest:
+    cycle_id: str
+    quantity: Decimal
+    reason: str
+    created_at: datetime
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class _WorkingExit:
+    order_id: str
+    quantity: Decimal
+    cumulative_filled: Decimal = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def working_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return self.quantity - self.cumulative_filled
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class _CycleState:
+    cycle_id: str
+    confirmed_entry_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+    confirmed_exit_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+    avg_fill_price: Decimal | None = None
+    status: str = "AWAITING_FILL"
+    protective_order_id: str | None = None
+    protective_order_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+    protective_cumulative_filled: Decimal = _ZERO
+    pending_replacement: bool = False
+    pending_exit_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+    pending_exit_reason: str | None = None
+    working_exit: _WorkingExit | None = None
+    updated_at: datetime | None = None
+    last_error: str | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def remaining_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        remaining = (
+            self.confirmed_entry_quantity
+            - self.confirmed_exit_quantity
+            - self.protective_cumulative_filled
+        )
+        return max(_ZERO, remaining)
+
+    @property
+    def working_protective_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        if self.protective_order_id is None:
+            return _ZERO
+        return self.protective_order_quantity - self.protective_cumulative_filled
+
+    @property
+    def working_exit_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return _ZERO if self.working_exit is None else self.working_exit.working_quantity
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _ProtectionSnapshot:
+    cycle_id: str
+    status: str
+    confirmed_remaining_quantity: Decimal
+    protective_order_id: str | None
+    protective_working_quantity: Decimal
+    exit_order_id: str | None
+    exit_working_quantity: Decimal
+    pending_replacement: bool
+    pending_exit_quantity: Decimal
+    updated_at: datetime | None
+    last_error: str | None
+
+    @property
+    def working_sell_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return self.protective_working_quantity + self.exit_working_quantity
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
+        relation = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite Decimal {relation}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _utc(value: object, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC (zero offset)")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _status(value: object) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
+        raise ValueError("status must be a non-empty string or status enum")
+    return raw.strip().upper()
+
+
+def _order_id(value: object) -> str:
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return _text(value, "broker order id")
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        for name in ("broker_order_id", "order_id", "id"):
+            if name in value:
+                return _text(value[name], "broker order id")
+    for name in ("broker_order_id", "order_id", "id"):
+        candidate = getattr(value, name, None)
+        if candidate is not None:
+            return _text(candidate, "broker order id")
+    raise ValueError("broker acknowledgement did not contain an order id")
+
+
+async def _await_if_needed(value: object) -> object:
+    return await value if inspect.isawaitable(value) else value
+
+
+class ProtectionCoordinator:
+    """Serialize protection and exit orders for each PositionCycle id."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        broker: _ProtectionBrokerPort,
+        clock: ClockPort,
+        policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    ) -> None:
+        if broker is None:
+            raise TypeError("broker is required")
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must provide now()")
+        if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+        self._broker = broker
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._policy = policy
+        self._cycles: dict[str, _CycleState] = {}
+        self._unprotected_cycles: set[str] = set()
+
+    @property
+    def entry_block_reasons(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        """Fresh-entry blocks raised by any currently unprotected filled cycle."""
+
+        if not self._unprotected_cycles:
+            return ()
+        return ("UNPROTECTED_POSITION",)
+
+    def check_entry_eligibility(
+        self,
+        policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+        capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+        mode: ExecutionMode | object,
+        intended_qty: Decimal,
+    ) -> ProtectionEligibility:
+        """Evaluate protection before entry submission.
+
+        ``entry_allowed`` on the result is false precisely when required
+        protection is ineligible.  No strategy pause or holding-period input is
+        accepted by this safety boundary.
+        """
+
+        return evaluate_policy(policy, capabilities, mode, intended_qty)
+
+    async def on_confirmed_fill(
+        self,
+        cycle_id: str,
+        cumulative_filled_qty: Decimal,
+        avg_fill_price: Decimal,
+        *,
+        confirmed: bool = True,
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot | None:
+        """Cover a positive, broker-confirmed cumulative entry fill."""
+
+        cycle = _text(cycle_id, "cycle_id")
+        quantity = _decimal(cumulative_filled_qty, "cumulative_filled_qty")
+        price = _decimal(avg_fill_price, "avg_fill_price", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(confirmed, bool):
+            raise TypeError("confirmed must be bool")
+        if not confirmed or quantity == _ZERO:
+            return self.current_protection(cycle)
+
+        state = self._cycles.setdefault(cycle, _CycleState(cycle_id=cycle))
+        if quantity < state.confirmed_entry_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("cumulative_filled_qty must not decrease")
+        state.confirmed_entry_quantity = quantity
+        state.avg_fill_price = price
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+
+        if state.working_exit is not None or state.pending_exit_quantity > _ZERO:
+            return self._snapshot(state)
+        if state.protective_order_id is None:
+            await self._place_protection(state)
+        elif state.working_protective_quantity != state.remaining_quantity:
+            await self._request_replacement(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    async def on_exit_requested(
+        self, cycle_id: str, qty: Decimal, reason: str
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        """Queue or submit an exit without overlapping an effective stop."""
+
+        state = self._require_cycle(cycle_id)
+        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
+        exit_reason = _text(reason, "reason")
+        if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("cannot exit a cycle with no confirmed remaining position")
+        if state.working_exit is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("an exit order is already working for this cycle")
+        requested = state.pending_exit_quantity + quantity
+        if requested > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("requested exit quantity exceeds confirmed remaining quantity")
+
+        state.pending_exit_quantity = requested
+        state.pending_exit_reason = exit_reason
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            if state.status != "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_EXIT":
+                state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_EXIT"
+                await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)
+        else:
+            await self._release_pending_exit(state)
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    async def on_broker_order_update(
+        self,
+        cycle_id: str,
+        order_id: str,
+        status: object,
+        *,
+        filled_qty: Decimal = _ZERO,
+        avg_fill_price: Decimal | None = None,
+        occurred_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        """Apply a normalized cumulative broker-order update."""
+
+        state = self._require_cycle(cycle_id)
+        broker_order_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        normalized = _status(status)
+        cumulative = _decimal(filled_qty, "filled_qty")
+        if avg_fill_price is not None:
+            _decimal(avg_fill_price, "avg_fill_price", positive=True)
+        state.updated_at = self._now() if occurred_at is None else _utc(occurred_at, "occurred_at")
+
+        if broker_order_id == state.protective_order_id:
+            await self._apply_protective_update(state, normalized, cumulative)
+        elif state.working_exit is not None and broker_order_id == state.working_exit.order_id:
+            await self._apply_exit_update(state, normalized, cumulative)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("order update does not belong to an effective order for this cycle")
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    def current_protection(self, cycle_id: str) -> _ProtectionSnapshot | None:
+        state = self._cycles.get(_text(cycle_id, "cycle_id"))
+        return None if state is None else self._snapshot(state)
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        return _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock.now()")
+
+    def _require_cycle(self, cycle_id: str) -> _CycleState:
+        cycle = _text(cycle_id, "cycle_id")
+        try:
+            return self._cycles[cycle]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown PositionCycle id: {cycle}") from None
+
+    async def _broker_call(self, preferred: str, fallback: str, request: object) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._broker, preferred, None)
+        if not callable(method):
+            method = getattr(self._broker, fallback, None)
+        if not callable(method):
+            raise TypeError(f"broker must provide {preferred}() or {fallback}()")
+        return await _await_if_needed(method(request))
+
+    async def _place_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        if state.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+            return
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("cannot place a second effective protective order")
+        if state.avg_fill_price is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("confirmed average fill price is required for protection")
+        request = _ProtectiveOrderRequest(
+            cycle_id=state.cycle_id,
+            quantity=state.remaining_quantity,
+            confirmed_avg_fill_price=state.avg_fill_price,
+            policy=self._policy,
+            created_at=self._now(),
+        )
+        try:
+            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call(
+                "submit_protective_order", "submit_order", request
+            )
+            state.protective_order_id = _order_id(acknowledgement)
+            state.protective_order_quantity = state.remaining_quantity
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            state.status = "PROTECTION_ACTIVE"
+            state.last_error = None
+            self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective placement failed: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+
+    async def _request_replacement(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        if state.protective_order_id is None:
+            await self._place_protection(state)
+            return
+        if state.status == "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT":
+            return
+        state.pending_replacement = True
+        state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT"
+        await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)
+
+    async def _cancel_effective_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        order_id = state.protective_order_id
+        if order_id is None:
+            return
+        cancel = getattr(self._broker, "cancel_order", None)
+        if not callable(cancel):
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, "broker must provide cancel_order()")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error)
+        try:
+            await _await_if_needed(cancel(order_id))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective cancellation failed: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+
+    async def _release_pending_exit(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        quantity = state.pending_exit_quantity
+        if quantity == _ZERO:
+            return
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("cannot release exit while protection remains effective")
+        if quantity > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise RuntimeError("pending exit exceeds confirmed remaining position")
+        reason = state.pending_exit_reason
+        assert reason is not None
+        request = _ExitOrderRequest(state.cycle_id, quantity, reason, self._now())
+        try:
+            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call("submit_exit_order", "submit_order", request)
+            state.working_exit = _WorkingExit(_order_id(acknowledgement), quantity)
+            state.pending_exit_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.pending_exit_reason = None
+            state.status = "EXIT_ACTIVE"
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"exit placement failed after protection cancel: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+
+    async def _apply_protective_update(
+        self, state: _CycleState, status: str, cumulative_filled: Decimal
+    ) -> None:
+        if cumulative_filled < state.protective_cumulative_filled:
+            raise ValueError("protective cumulative filled quantity must not decrease")
+        if cumulative_filled > state.protective_order_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("protective filled quantity exceeds its order quantity")
+        state.protective_cumulative_filled = cumulative_filled
+
+        if status in {"PARTIALLY_FILLED", "PARTIAL_FILL"}:
+            state.status = "PROTECTION_PARTIALLY_FILLED"
+            return
+        if status == "FILLED":
+            state.confirmed_exit_quantity += state.protective_cumulative_filled
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            state.status = "POSITION_CLOSED" if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO else "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+            if state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                self._mark_unprotected(state, "protective order filled without closing position")
+            else:
+                self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+            return
+        if status in {"CANCELED", "CANCELLED"}:
+            replace_after_cancel = state.pending_replacement
+            state.confirmed_exit_quantity += state.protective_cumulative_filled
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            if state.pending_exit_quantity > _ZERO:
+                await self._release_pending_exit(state)
+            elif replace_after_cancel and state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                await self._place_protection(state)
+            elif state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                self._mark_unprotected(state, "protective order canceled without replacement")
+            return
+        if status in {"REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}:
+            state.confirmed_exit_quantity += state.protective_cumulative_filled
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective order became {status}")
+            return
+        if status not in _TERMINAL:
+            # ACCEPTED/PENDING/NEW updates preserve the currently effective order.
+            return
+
+    async def _apply_exit_update(
+        self, state: _CycleState, status: str, cumulative_filled: Decimal
+    ) -> None:
+        working = state.working_exit
+        assert working is not None
+        if cumulative_filled < working.cumulative_filled:
+            raise ValueError("exit cumulative filled quantity must not decrease")
+        if cumulative_filled > working.quantity:
+            raise ValueError("exit filled quantity exceeds its order quantity")
+        delta = cumulative_filled - working.cumulative_filled
+        working.cumulative_filled = cumulative_filled
+        state.confirmed_exit_quantity += delta
+
+        if status in {"PARTIALLY_FILLED", "PARTIAL_FILL"}:
+            state.status = "EXIT_PARTIALLY_FILLED"
+            return
+        if status in _TERMINAL:
+            state.working_exit = None
+            if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO:
+                state.status = "POSITION_CLOSED"
+                self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+            else:
+                await self._place_protection(state)
+
+    def _mark_unprotected(self, state: _CycleState, message: str) -> None:
+        state.status = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+        state.last_error = message
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+        self._unprotected_cycles.add(state.cycle_id)
+
+    def _assert_sell_invariant(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        working = state.working_protective_quantity + state.working_exit_quantity
+        if working > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "working protective plus exit quantity exceeds confirmed remaining long quantity"
+            )
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None and state.working_exit is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("protective and discretionary sell orders must not overlap")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _snapshot(state: _CycleState) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        return _ProtectionSnapshot(
+            cycle_id=state.cycle_id,
+            status=state.status,
+            confirmed_remaining_quantity=state.remaining_quantity,
+            protective_order_id=state.protective_order_id,
+            protective_working_quantity=state.working_protective_quantity,
+            exit_order_id=None if state.working_exit is None else state.working_exit.order_id,
+            exit_working_quantity=state.working_exit_quantity,
+            pending_replacement=state.pending_replacement,
+            pending_exit_quantity=state.pending_exit_quantity,
+            updated_at=state.updated_at,
+            last_error=state.last_error,
+        )

+"""Provider-neutral protective-order policy and capability evaluation.
+
+Capability declarations are intentionally explicit and default to unsupported.
+An adapter must advertise both support and, for LIVE execution, the combinations
+that have already been demonstrated in PAPER.  This keeps an unknown provider
+combination from becoming an implicit live-trading experiment.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Iterable
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import OrderType, TimeInForce
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+__all__ = [
+    "ProtectionMode",
+    "ProtectionPolicy",
+    "BrokerProtectionCapabilities",
+    "ProtectionEligibility",
+    "evaluate_policy",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_STOP_MARKET = "STOP_MARKET"
+_STOP_LIMIT = "STOP_LIMIT"
+_TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
+_TRAIL_PRICE = "TRAIL_PRICE"
+_TRAIL_PERCENT = "TRAIL_PERCENT"
+_ALLOWED = "ALLOWED"
+_REJECTED = "REJECTED"
+
+_RISK_NOTES = (
+    "A stop trigger price is not a guaranteed execution price or maximum loss.",
+    "A stop-limit order may not fill.",
+    "DAY TIF expires and leaves an overnight residual unless protection is renewed.",
+)
+
+
+class ProtectionMode(StrEnum):
+    FIXED = "FIXED"
+    TRAILING_NATIVE = "TRAILING_NATIVE"
+    TRAILING_STEPPED = "TRAILING_STEPPED"
+
+
+def _positive_decimal(value: object, name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite positive Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+def _order_semantics(value: object) -> str:
+    raw = value.value if isinstance(value, OrderType) else value
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        raise TypeError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
+    normalized = raw.strip().upper()
+    if normalized == OrderType.STOP.value:
+        normalized = _STOP_MARKET
+    if normalized not in {_STOP_MARKET, _STOP_LIMIT}:
+        raise ValueError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _tif(value: object) -> TimeInForce:
+    if isinstance(value, TimeInForce):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return TimeInForce(value.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError("time_in_force must be DAY or GTC")
+
+
+def _mode_value(value: object) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw.upper() not in {item.value for item in ExecutionMode}:
+        raise ValueError("execution_mode must be BACKTEST, SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
+    return raw.upper()
+
+
+def _normalize_order_types(values: Iterable[object], name: str) -> frozenset[str]:
+    try:
+        normalized: set[str] = set()
+        for value in values:
+            raw = value.value if isinstance(value, OrderType) else value
+            if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip().upper() == _TRAILING_STOP:
+                normalized.add(_TRAILING_STOP)
+            else:
+                normalized.add(_order_semantics(value))
+        return frozenset(normalized)
+    except TypeError as exc:
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an iterable of order types") from exc
+
+
+def _normalize_tifs(values: Iterable[object], name: str) -> frozenset[TimeInForce]:
+    try:
+        return frozenset(_tif(value) for value in values)
+    except TypeError as exc:
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an iterable of TIF values") from exc
+
+
+def _normalize_combinations(
+    values: Iterable[tuple[object, object]], name: str
+) -> frozenset[tuple[str, TimeInForce]]:
+    result: set[tuple[str, TimeInForce]] = set()
+    try:
+        for order_type, tif in values:
+            normalized = _normalize_order_types((order_type,), name)
+            result.add((next(iter(normalized)), _tif(tif)))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise type(exc)(f"invalid {name}: {exc}") from exc
+    return frozenset(result)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ProtectionPolicy:
+    """One long-position protection rule.
+
+    ``fixed_reference`` is a provider-neutral reference name.  The default is
+    the broker-confirmed average fill; configured systems may use another
+    documented reference and resolve it before broker submission.
+    """
+
+    mode: ProtectionMode
+    required: bool = True
+    order_semantics: str | OrderType = _STOP_MARKET
+    limit_offset: Decimal | None = None
+    fixed_reference: str = "CONFIRMED_FILL_PRICE"
+    distance_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    distance_usd: Decimal | None = None
+    atr_multiple: Decimal | None = None
+    support_level: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
+    time_in_force: TimeInForce | str = TimeInForce.GTC
+    allow_fractional_protection: bool = False
+    documented_fractional_risk_ack: str | None = None
+    linked: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.mode, ProtectionMode):
+            try:
+                object.__setattr__(self, "mode", ProtectionMode(str(self.mode).upper()))
+            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise ValueError("mode must be a ProtectionMode") from exc
+        for name in ("required", "allow_fractional_protection", "linked"):
+            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), bool):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be bool")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "order_semantics", _order_semantics(self.order_semantics))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "time_in_force", _tif(self.time_in_force))
+        if not isinstance(self.fixed_reference, str) or not self.fixed_reference.strip():
+            raise ValueError("fixed_reference must be a non-empty string")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "fixed_reference", self.fixed_reference.strip().upper())
+
+        for name in (
+            "limit_offset",
+            "distance_percent",
+            "distance_usd",
+            "atr_multiple",
+            "support_level",
+            "trail_percent",
+            "trail_price",
+        ):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _positive_decimal(getattr(self, name), name))
+
+        if self.order_semantics == _STOP_LIMIT and self.limit_offset is None:
+            raise ValueError("STOP_LIMIT requires limit_offset")
+        if self.order_semantics == _STOP_MARKET and self.limit_offset is not None:
+            raise ValueError("STOP_MARKET does not accept limit_offset")
+
+        fixed_count = sum(
+            value is not None
+            for value in (

+                self.atr_multiple,

+        trail_count = int(self.trail_percent is not None) + int(self.trail_price is not None)

+            if fixed_count != 1:
+                raise ValueError("FIXED requires exactly one distance definition")

+                raise ValueError("documented_fractional_risk_ack must be non-empty when set")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "documented_fractional_risk_ack", ack.strip())
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BrokerProtectionCapabilities:
+    """Explicit supported and paper-proven protective-order combinations."""
+
+    supported_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    standalone_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+    fractional_combinations: frozenset[tuple[str | OrderType, TimeInForce | str]] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+    paper_proven_fractional_combinations: frozenset[
+        tuple[str | OrderType, TimeInForce | str]
+    ] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    supported_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+    linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(
+        default_factory=frozenset
+    )
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in (
+            "supported_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_order_types",
+            "fractional_combinations",
+            "paper_proven_fractional_combinations",
+            "supported_tifs",
+            "paper_proven_tifs",
+            "linked_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_linked_order_types",
+            "standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "linked_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters",
+        ):
+            if not isinstance(getattr(self, name), frozenset):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a frozenset")
+
+        for name in (
+            "supported_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_order_types",
+            "linked_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_linked_order_types",
+        ):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_order_types(getattr(self, name), name))
+        for name in ("supported_tifs", "paper_proven_tifs"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_tifs(getattr(self, name), name))
+        for name in ("fractional_combinations", "paper_proven_fractional_combinations"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _normalize_combinations(getattr(self, name), name))
+        for name in (
+            "standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "linked_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters",
+        ):
+            normalized = frozenset(str(value).strip().upper() for value in getattr(self, name))
+            if not normalized <= {_TRAIL_PRICE, _TRAIL_PERCENT}:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} contains an unsupported trailing parameter")
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, normalized)

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ProtectionEligibility:
+    status: str
+    reason_code: str | None
+    risk_notes: tuple[str, ...]
+    entry_allowed: bool
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.status not in {_ALLOWED, _REJECTED}:
+            raise ValueError("status must be ALLOWED or REJECTED")
+        if (self.reason_code is None) != (self.status == _ALLOWED):
+            raise ValueError("REJECTED requires a reason code; ALLOWED must not have one")
+
+    @property
+    def allowed(self) -> bool:
+        return self.status == _ALLOWED
+
+    @property
+    def rejected(self) -> bool:
+        return self.status == _REJECTED
+
+
+def _result(policy: ProtectionPolicy, reason: str | None = None) -> ProtectionEligibility:
+    allowed = reason is None
+    return ProtectionEligibility(
+        status=_ALLOWED if allowed else _REJECTED,
+        reason_code=reason,
+        risk_notes=_RISK_NOTES,
+        entry_allowed=allowed or not policy.required,
+    )
+
+
+def evaluate_policy(
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | object,
+    quantity: Decimal,
+) -> ProtectionEligibility:
+    """Return a deterministic, fail-closed capability decision."""
+
+    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+        raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+    if not isinstance(capabilities, BrokerProtectionCapabilities):
+        raise TypeError("capabilities must be BrokerProtectionCapabilities")
+    if not isinstance(quantity, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError("quantity must be Decimal")
+    if not quantity.is_finite() or quantity <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("quantity must be a finite positive Decimal")
+    live = _mode_value(execution_mode) == ExecutionMode.LIVE.value
+
+    if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_STEPPED:
+        return _result(policy, "STEPPED_NOT_AVAILABLE")
+    if policy.mode not in {ProtectionMode.FIXED, ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE}:
+        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_MODE")
+
+    order_type = (
+        _TRAILING_STOP
+        if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE
+        else str(policy.order_semantics)
+    )
+    tif = policy.time_in_force
+    assert isinstance(tif, TimeInForce)
+
+    if order_type not in capabilities.supported_order_types:
+        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+    if live and order_type not in capabilities.paper_proven_order_types:
+        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+
+    if tif not in capabilities.supported_tifs:
+        return _result(policy, "TIF_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+    if live and tif not in capabilities.paper_proven_tifs:
+        return _result(policy, "TIF_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+
+    trail_parameter: str | None = None
+    if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+        trail_parameter = _TRAIL_PRICE if policy.trail_price is not None else _TRAIL_PERCENT
+        if trail_parameter not in capabilities.standalone_trailing_parameters:
+            return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+        if live and trail_parameter not in capabilities.paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters:
+            return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+
+    if policy.linked:
+        if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
+            if trail_parameter not in capabilities.linked_trailing_parameters:
+                return _result(policy, "LINKED_TRAILING_UNSUPPORTED")
+            if live and trail_parameter not in capabilities.paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters:
+                return _result(policy, "LINKED_TRAILING_UNSUPPORTED")
+        else:
+            if order_type not in capabilities.linked_order_types:
+                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+            if live and order_type not in capabilities.paper_proven_linked_order_types:
+                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
+
+    fractional = quantity != quantity.to_integral_value()
+    if fractional:
+        if (
+            not policy.allow_fractional_protection
+            or policy.documented_fractional_risk_ack is None
+        ):
+            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+        combination = (order_type, tif)
+        if combination not in capabilities.fractional_combinations:
+            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_SUPPORTED")
+        if live and combination not in capabilities.paper_proven_fractional_combinations:
+            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_PAPER_PROVEN")
+
+    return _result(policy)
