class _SectionStore:
    """Per-scope, per-section document access serialized by an async lock."""

    _locks: WeakKeyDictionary[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop, dict[tuple[str, str], asyncio.Lock]] = (
        WeakKeyDictionary()
    )

    def __init__(self, section: str, repository: EntryEligibilityRepository | None) -> None:
        self._section = section
        self._repository = repository
        self._memory: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def _lock(self, scope: str) -> asyncio.Lock:
        loop_locks = self._locks.setdefault(asyncio.get_running_loop(), {})
        return loop_locks.setdefault((scope, self._section), asyncio.Lock())

    async def _load(self, scope: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._repository is None:
            return copy.deepcopy(self._memory.get(scope, {}))
        loaded = self._repository.load(scope, self._section)
        if inspect.isawaitable(loaded):
            loaded = await loaded
        if loaded is None:
            return {}
        if not isinstance(loaded, Mapping):
            raise TypeError("repository document must be a mapping")
        return copy.deepcopy(dict(loaded))

    async def read(self, scope: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        async with self._lock(scope):
            return await self._load(scope)

    async def update(self, scope: str, mutate: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], _T]) -> _T:
        async with self._lock(scope):
            original = await self._load(scope)
            document = copy.deepcopy(original)
            result = mutate(document)
            if document != original:
                if self._repository is not None:
                    saved = self._repository.save(scope, self._section, document)
                    if inspect.isawaitable(saved):
                        await saved
                self._memory[scope] = document
            return result

def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BudgetPolicy:
    """Capital limits for one execution account/scenario.

    ``total_budget_usd`` covers managed open-position entry notional plus
    pending entry reservations. ``symbol_budget_usd`` is the maximum size of
    one symbol's entry cycle; the reservation ledger separately prevents a
    second reservation while that cycle is pending or open.

    With margin disabled (the default), callers should supply settled cash or
    non-margin buying power to snapshots.  If both are supplied, the most
    conservative value is used.
    """

    total_budget_usd: Decimal
    symbol_budget_usd: Decimal
    reserve_usd: Decimal = _ZERO
    margin_enabled: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        total = _decimal(self.total_budget_usd, "total_budget_usd", positive=True)
        symbol = _decimal(self.symbol_budget_usd, "symbol_budget_usd", positive=True)
        reserve = _decimal(self.reserve_usd, "reserve_usd")
        if symbol > total:
            raise ValueError("symbol_budget_usd must not exceed total_budget_usd")
        if not isinstance(self.margin_enabled, bool):
            raise TypeError("margin_enabled must be bool")
        object.__setattr__(self, "total_budget_usd", total)
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol_budget_usd", symbol)
        object.__setattr__(self, "reserve_usd", reserve)

    @property
    def broker_reserve_usd(self) -> Decimal:
        """Explicit alias for integrations that call the reserve broker-facing."""
        return self.reserve_usd

    @property
    def total_application_budget(self) -> Decimal:
        """Compatibility name used by the existing configuration domain."""
        return self.total_budget_usd

    @property
    def per_symbol_budget(self) -> Decimal:
        """Compatibility name used by the existing configuration domain."""
        return self.symbol_budget_usd


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BudgetSnapshot:
    """A point-in-time view of usable managed capital for one symbol."""

    account_scope_id: str
    symbol: str
    application_budget_usd: Decimal
    symbol_budget_usd: Decimal
    committed_open_notional_usd: Decimal
    pending_reserved_usd: Decimal
    remaining_application_usd: Decimal
    remaining_symbol_usd: Decimal
    broker_available_usd: Decimal
    effective_cap_usd: Decimal
    remaining_total_usd: Decimal

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "account_scope_id", _text(self.account_scope_id, "account_scope_id")
        )
        symbol = _text(self.symbol, "symbol").upper()
        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
        for name in (
            "application_budget_usd",
            "symbol_budget_usd",
            "committed_open_notional_usd",
            "pending_reserved_usd",
            "remaining_application_usd",
            "remaining_symbol_usd",
            "broker_available_usd",
            "effective_cap_usd",
            "remaining_total_usd",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, _decimal(getattr(self, name), name))
        if self.remaining_total_usd != self.effective_cap_usd:
            raise ValueError("remaining_total_usd must equal effective_cap_usd")

    @property
    def remaining_per_symbol_usd(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.remaining_symbol_usd

    @property
    def committed_open_notional(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.committed_open_notional_usd

    @property
    def pending_reserved(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.pending_reserved_usd

    @property
    def remaining_total(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.remaining_total_usd

    @classmethod
    def calculate(
        cls,
        *,
        policy: BudgetPolicy,
        account_scope_id: str,
        symbol: str,
        committed_open_notional_usd: Decimal,
        pending_reserved_usd: Decimal,
        symbol_committed_open_notional_usd: Decimal,
        symbol_pending_reserved_usd: Decimal,
        broker_buying_power_usd: Decimal,
        settled_cash_usd: Decimal | None = None,
        non_margin_buying_power_usd: Decimal | None = None,
        non_marginable_buying_power_usd: Decimal | None = None,
    ) -> BudgetSnapshot:
        """Build a snapshot without counting external positions as commitment.

        Broker buying power already incorporates external/unmanaged holdings.
        Pending application reservations are deducted because they can exist
        before the broker has reflected their orders.
        """
        if not isinstance(policy, BudgetPolicy):
            raise TypeError("policy must be BudgetPolicy")
        committed = _decimal(
            committed_open_notional_usd, "committed_open_notional_usd"
        )
        pending = _decimal(pending_reserved_usd, "pending_reserved_usd")
        symbol_committed = _decimal(
            symbol_committed_open_notional_usd,
            "symbol_committed_open_notional_usd",
        )
        symbol_pending = _decimal(
            symbol_pending_reserved_usd, "symbol_pending_reserved_usd"
        )
        broker_power = _decimal(broker_buying_power_usd, "broker_buying_power_usd")

        non_margin_values: list[Decimal] = []
        if settled_cash_usd is not None:
            non_margin_values.append(_decimal(settled_cash_usd, "settled_cash_usd"))
        if non_margin_buying_power_usd is not None:
            non_margin_values.append(
                _decimal(non_margin_buying_power_usd, "non_margin_buying_power_usd")
            )
        if non_marginable_buying_power_usd is not None:
            non_margin_values.append(
                _decimal(
                    non_marginable_buying_power_usd,
                    "non_marginable_buying_power_usd",
                )
            )
        if policy.margin_enabled:
            eligible_broker_power = broker_power
        elif non_margin_values:
            eligible_broker_power = min(broker_power, *non_margin_values)
        else:
            # Some cash-only brokers expose their non-margin value solely as
            # ``buying_power``.  The caller remains responsible for provenance.
            eligible_broker_power = broker_power

        application_remaining = max(
            _ZERO, policy.total_budget_usd - committed - pending
        )
        symbol_remaining = max(
            _ZERO, policy.symbol_budget_usd - symbol_committed - symbol_pending
        )
        broker_available = max(
            _ZERO, eligible_broker_power - policy.reserve_usd - pending
        )
        effective = min(application_remaining, broker_available)
        return cls(
            account_scope_id=account_scope_id,
            symbol=symbol,
            application_budget_usd=policy.total_budget_usd,
            symbol_budget_usd=policy.symbol_budget_usd,
            committed_open_notional_usd=committed,
            pending_reserved_usd=pending,
            remaining_application_usd=application_remaining,
            remaining_symbol_usd=symbol_remaining,
            broker_available_usd=broker_available,
            effective_cap_usd=effective,
            remaining_total_usd=effective,
        )

    stop_offset_amount: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
    trail_amount: Decimal | None = None
    step_size: Decimal | None = None
    activation_gain: Decimal | None = None
    require_broker_held: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.kind, ProtectionKind):
            raise ValueError("kind must be ProtectionKind")
        for field in (
            "stop_offset_percent",
            "stop_offset_amount",
            "trail_percent",
            "trail_amount",
            "step_size",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(
                self, field, _optional_decimal(getattr(self, field), field=field)
            )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "activation_gain",
            _optional_decimal(self.activation_gain, field="activation_gain", positive=False),
        )
        if not isinstance(self.require_broker_held, bool):
            raise ValueError("require_broker_held must be bool")

        stop_count = int(self.stop_offset_percent is not None) + int(
            self.stop_offset_amount is not None
        )
        trail_count = int(self.trail_percent is not None) + int(
            self.trail_amount is not None
        )
        if self.kind is ProtectionKind.FIXED_STOP:
            if stop_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("FIXED_STOP requires exactly one stop offset")
            if trail_count or self.step_size is not None or self.activation_gain is not None:
                raise ValueError("FIXED_STOP does not accept trailing or stepped fields")
        elif self.kind is ProtectionKind.BROKER_TRAILING_STOP:
            if trail_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("BROKER_TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
            if stop_count or self.step_size is not None or self.activation_gain is not None:
                raise ValueError("BROKER_TRAILING_STOP accepts only a trail value")
        else:
            if trail_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
            if self.step_size is None or self.activation_gain is None:
                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires step_size and activation_gain")
            if stop_count:
                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP does not accept fixed-stop fields")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TrailingStopState:
    cycle_id: str
    account_scope_id: str
    symbol: str
    kind: ProtectionKind
    status: ProtectionStatus
    covered_quantity: Decimal
    stop_price: Decimal
    high_water_mark: Decimal
    broker_order_id: str | None = None
    last_confirmed_at: datetime | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("cycle_id", "account_scope_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
        if not isinstance(self.kind, ProtectionKind):
            raise ValueError("kind must be ProtectionKind")
        if not isinstance(self.status, ProtectionStatus):
            raise ValueError("status must be ProtectionStatus")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "covered_quantity",
            _require_decimal(
                self.covered_quantity,
                field="covered_quantity",
                minimum=_ZERO,
                inclusive=False,
            ),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "stop_price",
            _require_decimal(
                self.stop_price, field="stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
            ),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "high_water_mark",
            _require_decimal(
                self.high_water_mark,
                field="high_water_mark",
                minimum=_ZERO,
                inclusive=False,
            ),
        )
        if self.stop_price > self.high_water_mark:
            raise ValueError("stop_price must not exceed high_water_mark for a long")
        if self.broker_order_id is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                "broker_order_id",
                _require_text(self.broker_order_id, field="broker_order_id"),
            )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "last_confirmed_at",
            _optional_utc(self.last_confirmed_at, field="last_confirmed_at"),
        )

    def ratchet(self, new_stop_price: Decimal, observed_high: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
        new_stop = _require_decimal(
            new_stop_price, field="new_stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        new_high = _require_decimal(
            observed_high, field="observed_high", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        if new_stop < self.stop_price:
            raise ValueError("a long protective stop must never move downward")
        if new_high < self.high_water_mark:
            raise ValueError("a long high_water_mark must never move downward")
        if new_stop > new_high:
            raise ValueError("new_stop_price must not exceed observed_high")
        return replace(self, stop_price=new_stop, high_water_mark=new_high)

    def with_covered_quantity(self, remaining: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
        quantity = _require_decimal(
            remaining, field="remaining", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        if quantity > self.covered_quantity:
            raise ValueError("covered quantity must not exceed confirmed remaining quantity")
        return replace(self, covered_quantity=quantity)


def _offset_price(
    fill_price: Decimal, *, percent: Decimal | None, amount: Decimal | None
) -> Decimal:
    if amount is not None:
        return fill_price - amount
    if percent is None:  # Protected by ProtectionPolicy validation.
        raise ValueError("a percent or amount offset is required")
    return fill_price * (Decimal("1") - percent / Decimal("100"))


def start_protection(
    policy: ProtectionPolicy, cycle: "PositionCycle", fill_price: Decimal  # noqa: UP037
) -> TrailingStopState:
    """Create pending protection after a confirmed positive entry fill."""

    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
        raise ValueError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
    price = _require_decimal(
        fill_price, field="fill_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
    )
    entry_quantity = getattr(cycle, "entry_quantity", None)
    remaining_quantity = getattr(cycle, "remaining_quantity", None)
    if not isinstance(entry_quantity, Decimal) or entry_quantity <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive filled entry quantity")
    if not isinstance(remaining_quantity, Decimal) or remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive remaining quantity")

    if policy.kind is ProtectionKind.FIXED_STOP:
        stop = _offset_price(
            price,
            percent=policy.stop_offset_percent,
            amount=policy.stop_offset_amount,
        )
    else:
        stop = _offset_price(
            price, percent=policy.trail_percent, amount=policy.trail_amount
        )
    stop = _require_decimal(stop, field="stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False)
    return TrailingStopState(
        cycle_id=_require_text(getattr(cycle, "cycle_id", None), field="cycle_id"),
        account_scope_id=_require_text(
            getattr(cycle, "account_scope_id", None), field="account_scope_id"
        ),
        symbol=_require_symbol(getattr(cycle, "symbol", None)),
        kind=policy.kind,
        status=ProtectionStatus.PENDING,
        covered_quantity=remaining_quantity,
        stop_price=stop,
        high_water_mark=price,
    )


def combined_sell_exposure(
    protective_qty: Decimal, pending_exit_qty: Decimal, position_qty: Decimal
) -> bool:
    """Report whether overlapping sell orders could create a short position."""

    protective = _require_decimal(protective_qty, field="protective_qty")
    pending = _require_decimal(pending_exit_qty, field="pending_exit_qty")
    position = _require_decimal(position_qty, field="position_qty")
    return protective + pending > position

The module deliberately depends only on the Python standard library.

Design choices (3 of the task's 4-decision budget):
1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at construction, while opaque IDs are
   stripped but otherwise preserved.
2. A cycle's realized P&L is the literal exit proceeds minus total entry cost
   minus every recorded entry and exit fee; planned partial exits are outside
   this contract.
3. ``entry_blocked`` returns stored reasons and adds the stable reason
   ``"locked_until"`` only while the state's UTC lock deadline is in the future.
"""

_ZERO = Decimal("0")


def _require_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_symbol(value: object) -> str:
    symbol = _require_text(value, field="symbol").upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
    return symbol


def _require_decimal(
    value: object,
    *,
    field: str,
    minimum: Decimal = _ZERO,
    inclusive: bool = True,
) -> Decimal:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
    if value < minimum or (not inclusive and value == minimum):
        operator = ">=" if inclusive else ">"
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator} {minimum}")
    return value


def _optional_decimal(
    value: object,
    *,
    field: str,
    minimum: Decimal = _ZERO,
    inclusive: bool = True,
) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _require_decimal(value, field=field, minimum=minimum, inclusive=inclusive)


def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware UTC")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be UTC")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _optional_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _require_utc(value, field=field)


def _require_enum(value: object, enum_type: type[Enum], *, field: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, enum_type):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {enum_type.__name__}")


def _require_int(value: object, *, field: str, minimum: int) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be int")
    if value < minimum:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be >= {minimum}")
    return value


def _require_duration(value: object, *, field: str) -> timedelta:
    if not isinstance(value, timedelta):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timedelta")
    if value < timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be >= 0")
    return value


def _validate_order_prices(
    order_type: OrderType,
    limit_price: Decimal | None,
    stop_price: Decimal | None,
    trail_price: Decimal | None,
    trail_percent: Decimal | None,
) -> None:
    if order_type in {OrderType.LIMIT, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
        if limit_price is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders require limit_price")
    elif limit_price is not None:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify limit_price")

    if order_type in {OrderType.STOP, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
        if stop_price is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders require stop_price")
    elif stop_price is not None:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify stop_price")

    trail_count = int(trail_price is not None) + int(trail_percent is not None)
    if order_type is OrderType.TRAILING_STOP:
        if trail_count != 1:
            raise ValueError("TRAILING_STOP orders require exactly one trail value")
    elif trail_count:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify a trail value")

"""Immutable protective-stop policy and trailing-state contracts.

This module imports the trading contract only for static type checking; at
runtime, ``start_protection`` uses the small structural surface supplied by a
position cycle.

Design choice (the task's final design choice): ``with_covered_quantity``
treats the state's current coverage as the last confirmed maximum remaining
position.  It can resize downward to a newly confirmed remainder, while an
increase requires rebuilding protection from a freshly observed cycle.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from mike_trade.domain.trading import PositionCycle

__all__ = [
    "ProtectionKind",
    "ProtectionStatus",
    "ProtectionPolicy",
    "TrailingStopState",
    "start_protection",
    "combined_sell_exposure",
]

_ZERO = Decimal("0")


def _require_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_symbol(value: object) -> str:
    symbol = _require_text(value, field="symbol").upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
    return symbol


def _require_decimal(
    value: object,
    *,
    field: str,
    minimum: Decimal = _ZERO,
    inclusive: bool = True,
) -> Decimal:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
    if value < minimum or (not inclusive and value == minimum):
        operator = ">=" if inclusive else ">"
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator} {minimum}")
    return value


def _optional_decimal(
    value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = True
) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _require_decimal(value, field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=not positive)


def _optional_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware UTC")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be UTC")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


class ProtectionKind(Enum):
    FIXED_STOP = "FIXED_STOP"
    BROKER_TRAILING_STOP = "BROKER_TRAILING_STOP"
    STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP = "STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP"


class ProtectionStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "PENDING"
    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
    REPLACING = "REPLACING"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"
    CANCELED = "CANCELED"
    TRIGGERED = "TRIGGERED"
    UNSUPPORTED = "UNSUPPORTED"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProtectionPolicy:
    kind: ProtectionKind
    stop_offset_percent: Decimal | None = None
    stop_offset_amount: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
    trail_amount: Decimal | None = None
    step_size: Decimal | None = None
    activation_gain: Decimal | None = None
    require_broker_held: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.kind, ProtectionKind):
            raise ValueError("kind must be ProtectionKind")
        for field in (
            "stop_offset_percent",
            "stop_offset_amount",
            "trail_percent",
            "trail_amount",
            "step_size",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(
                self, field, _optional_decimal(getattr(self, field), field=field)
            )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "activation_gain",
            _optional_decimal(self.activation_gain, field="activation_gain", positive=False),
        )
        if not isinstance(self.require_broker_held, bool):
            raise ValueError("require_broker_held must be bool")

        stop_count = int(self.stop_offset_percent is not None) + int(
            self.stop_offset_amount is not None
        )
        trail_count = int(self.trail_percent is not None) + int(
            self.trail_amount is not None
        )
        if self.kind is ProtectionKind.FIXED_STOP:
            if stop_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("FIXED_STOP requires exactly one stop offset")
            if trail_count or self.step_size is not None or self.activation_gain is not None:
                raise ValueError("FIXED_STOP does not accept trailing or stepped fields")
        elif self.kind is ProtectionKind.BROKER_TRAILING_STOP:
            if trail_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("BROKER_TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
            if stop_count or self.step_size is not None or self.activation_gain is not None:
                raise ValueError("BROKER_TRAILING_STOP accepts only a trail value")
        else:
            if trail_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
            if self.step_size is None or self.activation_gain is None:
                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires step_size and activation_gain")
            if stop_count:
                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP does not accept fixed-stop fields")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TrailingStopState:
    cycle_id: str
    account_scope_id: str
    symbol: str
    kind: ProtectionKind
    status: ProtectionStatus
    covered_quantity: Decimal
    stop_price: Decimal
    high_water_mark: Decimal
    broker_order_id: str | None = None
    last_confirmed_at: datetime | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("cycle_id", "account_scope_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
        if not isinstance(self.kind, ProtectionKind):
            raise ValueError("kind must be ProtectionKind")
        if not isinstance(self.status, ProtectionStatus):
            raise ValueError("status must be ProtectionStatus")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "covered_quantity",
            _require_decimal(
                self.covered_quantity,
                field="covered_quantity",
                minimum=_ZERO,
                inclusive=False,
            ),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "stop_price",
            _require_decimal(
                self.stop_price, field="stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
            ),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "high_water_mark",
            _require_decimal(
                self.high_water_mark,
                field="high_water_mark",
                minimum=_ZERO,
                inclusive=False,
            ),
        )
        if self.stop_price > self.high_water_mark:
            raise ValueError("stop_price must not exceed high_water_mark for a long")
        if self.broker_order_id is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                "broker_order_id",
                _require_text(self.broker_order_id, field="broker_order_id"),
            )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "last_confirmed_at",
            _optional_utc(self.last_confirmed_at, field="last_confirmed_at"),
        )

    def ratchet(self, new_stop_price: Decimal, observed_high: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
        new_stop = _require_decimal(
            new_stop_price, field="new_stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        new_high = _require_decimal(
            observed_high, field="observed_high", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        if new_stop < self.stop_price:
            raise ValueError("a long protective stop must never move downward")
        if new_high < self.high_water_mark:
            raise ValueError("a long high_water_mark must never move downward")
        if new_stop > new_high:
            raise ValueError("new_stop_price must not exceed observed_high")
        return replace(self, stop_price=new_stop, high_water_mark=new_high)

    def with_covered_quantity(self, remaining: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
        quantity = _require_decimal(
            remaining, field="remaining", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        if quantity > self.covered_quantity:
            raise ValueError("covered quantity must not exceed confirmed remaining quantity")
        return replace(self, covered_quantity=quantity)


def _offset_price(
    fill_price: Decimal, *, percent: Decimal | None, amount: Decimal | None
) -> Decimal:
    if amount is not None:
        return fill_price - amount
    if percent is None:  # Protected by ProtectionPolicy validation.
        raise ValueError("a percent or amount offset is required")
    return fill_price * (Decimal("1") - percent / Decimal("100"))


def start_protection(
    policy: ProtectionPolicy, cycle: "PositionCycle", fill_price: Decimal  # noqa: UP037
) -> TrailingStopState:
    """Create pending protection after a confirmed positive entry fill."""

    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
        raise ValueError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
    price = _require_decimal(
        fill_price, field="fill_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
    )
    entry_quantity = getattr(cycle, "entry_quantity", None)
    remaining_quantity = getattr(cycle, "remaining_quantity", None)
    if not isinstance(entry_quantity, Decimal) or entry_quantity <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive filled entry quantity")
    if not isinstance(remaining_quantity, Decimal) or remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive remaining quantity")

    if policy.kind is ProtectionKind.FIXED_STOP:
        stop = _offset_price(
            price,
            percent=policy.stop_offset_percent,
            amount=policy.stop_offset_amount,
        )
    else:
        stop = _offset_price(
            price, percent=policy.trail_percent, amount=policy.trail_amount
        )
    stop = _require_decimal(stop, field="stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False)
    return TrailingStopState(
        cycle_id=_require_text(getattr(cycle, "cycle_id", None), field="cycle_id"),
        account_scope_id=_require_text(
            getattr(cycle, "account_scope_id", None), field="account_scope_id"
        ),
        symbol=_require_symbol(getattr(cycle, "symbol", None)),
        kind=policy.kind,
        status=ProtectionStatus.PENDING,
        covered_quantity=remaining_quantity,
        stop_price=stop,
        high_water_mark=price,
    )

def _require_utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> None:
    """Require an aware datetime whose UTC offset is zero."""
    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a UTC-aware datetime")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC (zero offset)")


def _require_decimal(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
    if value is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")


def _require_nonempty(value: str, name: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.environment, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("environment must be an AccountEnvironment")
        _require_nonempty(self.account_id, "account_id")
        if self.environment in (AccountEnvironment.SHADOW, AccountEnvironment.BACKTEST):

            raise ValueError("cycle fills must be Fill instances")
        fill_ids = [fill.fill_id for fill in all_fills]
        if len(fill_ids) != len(set(fill_ids)):
            raise ValueError("fill_id values must be unique within a cycle")
        for fill in all_fills:
            if fill.account_scope_id != self.account_scope_id or fill.symbol != self.symbol:

        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY for fill in self.entry_fills):

            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")

    def apply_exit_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.EXITING:
            raise ValueError("exit fills require an EXITING cycle")
        if fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL:
            raise ValueError("exit fill side must be SELL")

            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")

            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")

                state=PositionCycleState.CLOSED,
                exit_fills=fills,

    @property
    def entry_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)

    @property
    def exit_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)

    @property
    def remaining_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.entry_quantity - self.exit_quantity

    @property
    def avg_entry_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
        if self.entry_quantity == _ZERO:
            return None
        cost = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)
        return cost / self.entry_quantity

    @property
    def avg_exit_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
        if self.exit_quantity == _ZERO:
            return None
        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
        return proceeds / self.exit_quantity

    @property
    def realized_pnl(self) -> Decimal:
        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
        entry_cost = sum(
            (fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO
        )
        fees = sum((fill.fee for fill in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
        return proceeds - entry_cost - fees

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any

from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
from mike_trade.domain.trading import OrderSide, OrderType, TimeInForce
from mike_trade.persistence.journal import DomainEventJournal, NewEvent, RecordedEvent

from .order_fsm import OrderStatus

__all__ = ["OrderIntent", "OrderPurpose", "IntentStore", "persist_intent"]

_ZERO = Decimal("0")
_INTENT_EVENT = "OrderIntentPersisted"
_IDEMPOTENCY_PREFIX = "order-intent:"


class OrderPurpose(Enum):
    """Enabled long-only reasons for placing an order.

    Short-entry and short-cover purposes are intentionally absent.  Adding enum
    names in the future does not enable those capabilities; validation and the
    broker capability boundary must opt in separately.
    """

    ENTRY_LONG = "ENTRY_LONG"
    EXIT_LONG = "EXIT_LONG"
    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "PROTECTIVE_STOP"
    TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
    MANUAL_CLOSE = "MANUAL_CLOSE"
    SAFETY_EXIT = "SAFETY_EXIT"


def _text(value: object, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
    return value.strip()


def _utc(value: object, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a UTC-aware datetime")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must use UTC")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _positive_decimal(value: object, field: str) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite() or value <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a finite positive Decimal")
    return value


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrderIntent:
    """Immutable instruction whose durable identity precedes broker submission."""

    intent_id: str
    execution_mode: AccountEnvironment
    account_key: str
    symbol: str
    side: OrderSide
    purpose: OrderPurpose
    position_cycle_id: str
    order_type: OrderType
    time_in_force: TimeInForce
    signal_bar_time: datetime
    signal_expires_at: datetime
    quote_reference_time: datetime
    client_order_id: str
    attempt_number: int
    created_at: datetime
    originating_strategy_id: str | None = None
    qty: Decimal | None = None
    notional: Decimal | None = None
    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("intent_id", "account_key", "position_cycle_id", "client_order_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _text(getattr(self, field), field))
        symbol = _text(self.symbol, "symbol").upper()
        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)

        if not isinstance(self.execution_mode, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("execution_mode must be an AccountEnvironment")
        if self.execution_mode not in {
            AccountEnvironment.SHADOW,
            AccountEnvironment.PAPER,
            AccountEnvironment.LIVE,
        }:
            raise ValueError("execution_mode must be SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
        if not isinstance(self.side, OrderSide):
            raise TypeError("side must be an OrderSide")
        if not isinstance(self.purpose, OrderPurpose):
            raise TypeError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose")
        if not isinstance(self.order_type, OrderType):
            raise TypeError("order_type must be an OrderType")
        if not isinstance(self.time_in_force, TimeInForce):
            raise TypeError("time_in_force must be a TimeInForce")
        if isinstance(self.attempt_number, bool) or not isinstance(self.attempt_number, int):
            raise TypeError("attempt_number must be int")
        if self.attempt_number < 0:
            raise ValueError("attempt_number must be >= 0")

        for field in (
            "signal_bar_time",
            "signal_expires_at",
            "quote_reference_time",
            "created_at",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _utc(getattr(self, field), field))
        if self.signal_expires_at < self.signal_bar_time:
            raise ValueError("signal_expires_at must not precede signal_bar_time")

        if self.originating_strategy_id is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                "originating_strategy_id",
                _text(self.originating_strategy_id, "originating_strategy_id"),
            )

        for field in (
            "qty",
            "notional",
            "limit_price",
            "stop_price",
            "trail_price",
            "trail_percent",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _positive_decimal(getattr(self, field), field))
        if (self.qty is None) == (self.notional is None):
            raise ValueError("exactly one of qty or notional is required")
        self._validate_prices()

        required_side = OrderSide.BUY if self.purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG else OrderSide.SELL
        if self.side is not required_side:
            if self.purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG:
                raise ValueError("short-opening sides are disabled; ENTRY_LONG requires BUY")
            raise ValueError(f"{self.purpose.value} is a long exit and requires SELL")

    @property
    def account_scope_id(self) -> str:
        """Environment-qualified persistence identity."""
        return f"{self.execution_mode.value.lower()}:{self.account_key}"

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, **values: Any) -> OrderIntent:
        """Build an intent using the existing stable client-order-ID helper.

        Callers may still invoke the normal constructor when a provider-neutral
        externally allocated ID is already durable.
        """
        if "client_order_id" in values:
            raise TypeError("create() derives client_order_id; do not pass it")
        try:
            mode = values["execution_mode"]
            account_key = values["account_key"]
            cycle_id = values["position_cycle_id"]
            purpose = values["purpose"]
            attempt = values["attempt_number"]
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise TypeError(f"create() missing required argument: {exc.args[0]}") from None
        if not isinstance(purpose, OrderPurpose):
            raise TypeError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose")
        # This is intentionally lazy: the intent model and durable store stay
        # usable without importing a concrete broker adapter.
        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import OrderPurpose as AlpacaOrderPurpose
        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import make_client_order_id

        alpaca_purpose = {
            OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG: AlpacaOrderPurpose.ENTRY,
            OrderPurpose.EXIT_LONG: AlpacaOrderPurpose.EXIT,
            OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP: AlpacaOrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP,
            OrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP: AlpacaOrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP,
            OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE: AlpacaOrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
            OrderPurpose.SAFETY_EXIT: AlpacaOrderPurpose.SAFETY_EXIT,
        }[purpose]
        values["client_order_id"] = make_client_order_id(
            mode, account_key, cycle_id, alpaca_purpose, attempt
        )
        return cls(**values)

    def _validate_prices(self) -> None:
        if self.order_type in {OrderType.LIMIT, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
            if self.limit_price is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} requires limit_price")
        elif self.limit_price is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} must not specify limit_price")

        if self.order_type in {OrderType.STOP, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
            if self.stop_price is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} requires stop_price")
        elif self.stop_price is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} must not specify stop_price")

        trail_count = int(self.trail_price is not None) + int(self.trail_percent is not None)
        if self.order_type is OrderType.TRAILING_STOP:
            if trail_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
        elif trail_count:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} must not specify a trail value")

class MemoryRepository:

def fill(fid, order="o1", side=OrderSide.BUY, qty="10", price="10", fee="0", at=THU,
         symbol="AAPL", scope=SCOPE):
    return Fill(fid, order, scope, symbol, side, D(qty), D(price), D(fee), at)


def closed_cycle(cid, exit_price, *, entry_price="10", fee="0", strategy="vwap",
                 symbol="AAPL", scope=SCOPE, closed_at=THU + timedelta(hours=1)):
    cycle = PositionCycle(cid, scope, symbol, entry_strategy_key=strategy)
    cycle = cycle.apply_entry_fill(
        fill(f"{cid}-b", f"{cid}-bo", price=entry_price, fee=fee, at=THU,
             symbol=symbol, scope=scope)
    )
    cycle = cycle.begin_exit().apply_exit_fill(
        fill(f"{cid}-s", f"{cid}-so", OrderSide.SELL, price=exit_price, fee=fee,
             at=closed_at, symbol=symbol, scope=scope)
    )
    assert cycle.state is PositionCycleState.CLOSED
    return cycle


def closed_at(cycle: PositionCycle) -> datetime:
    assert cycle.closed_at is not None
    return cycle.closed_at


def build(repo=None, *, cycles=3, threshold: int | None = 2, mode=LockoutResetMode.NEXT_SESSION,
          by_strategy=False, cooldown=0, max_open=None, daily=None, now=THU):
    clock = lambda: now  # noqa: E731
    counter = EntryCycleCounter(cycles, repo, clock)
    tracker = LosingStreakTracker(
        threshold, mode, scope_by_strategy=by_strategy, repository=repo, clock=clock
    )
    cool = PostSaleCooldown(cooldown, repo, clock)
    evaluator = EntryEligibilityEvaluator(
        counter, tracker, cool, max_open_positions=max_open, daily_loss_limit=daily, clock=clock
    )
    return counter, tracker, cool, evaluator

"""Provider-neutral order status transitions.

Status changes deliberately do not own executed quantity.  An event can carry
``filled_qty`` only when it represents a fill-bearing update, leaving the fill
ledger as the authoritative owner of quantity changes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum
from typing import Literal

__all__ = [
    "OrderStatus",
    "OrderEvent",
    "TransitionResult",
    "IllegalOrderTransition",
    "apply_transition",
    "TERMINAL_STATUSES",
]


class OrderStatus(Enum):
    INTENT_PERSISTED = "INTENT_PERSISTED"
    SUBMITTING = "SUBMITTING"
    ACCEPTED = "ACCEPTED"
    PENDING = "PENDING"
    PARTIALLY_FILLED = "PARTIALLY_FILLED"
    FILLED = "FILLED"
    REJECTED = "REJECTED"
    CANCEL_PENDING = "CANCEL_PENDING"
    CANCELED = "CANCELED"
    EXPIRED = "EXPIRED"
    REPLACED = "REPLACED"
    SUSPENDED = "SUSPENDED"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"


TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset(
    {
        OrderStatus.FILLED,
        OrderStatus.REJECTED,
        OrderStatus.CANCELED,
        OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
        OrderStatus.REPLACED,
    }
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrderEvent:
    """One normalized broker/order-lifecycle observation.

    ``broker_lookup`` is required when resolving ``UNKNOWN``.  ``broker_confirmed``
    distinguishes final broker state from a local cancel/replace request or an
    acknowledgement that has not yet confirmed the final state.
    """

    status: OrderStatus
    filled_qty: Decimal | None = None
    broker_lookup: bool = False
    broker_confirmed: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.status, OrderStatus):
            raise TypeError("status must be an OrderStatus")
        if not isinstance(self.broker_lookup, bool):
            raise TypeError("broker_lookup must be bool")
        if not isinstance(self.broker_confirmed, bool):
            raise TypeError("broker_confirmed must be bool")
        is_fill_status = self.status in {
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
        }
        if self.filled_qty is None:
            return
        if not isinstance(self.filled_qty, Decimal):
            raise TypeError("filled_qty must be Decimal")
        if not self.filled_qty.is_finite() or self.filled_qty <= 0:
            raise ValueError("filled_qty must be a finite positive Decimal")
        if not is_fill_status:
            raise ValueError("filled_qty may change only through fill-bearing events")


class IllegalOrderTransition(ValueError):
    """Typed evidence that an event cannot change the current order state."""

    def __init__(self, current: OrderStatus, event: OrderEvent, reason: str) -> None:
        self.current = current
        self.event = event
        self.reason = reason
        super().__init__(
            f"illegal order transition {current.value} -> {event.status.value}: {reason}"
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TransitionResult:
    previous_status: OrderStatus
    status: OrderStatus
    event: OrderEvent
    outcome: Literal["accepted", "ignored", "illegal"]
    error: IllegalOrderTransition | None = None

    @property
    def accepted(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "accepted"

    @property
    def ignored(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "ignored"

    @property
    def illegal(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "illegal"

    @property
    def filled_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
        """Return fill data only when its fill-bearing transition was accepted."""
        return self.event.filled_qty if self.accepted else None

    def raise_for_illegal(self) -> None:
        if self.error is not None:

+
+Capability declarations are intentionally explicit and default to unsupported.

+

+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Iterable
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import OrderType, TimeInForce
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+__all__ = [
+    "ProtectionMode",
+    "ProtectionPolicy",
+    "BrokerProtectionCapabilities",
+    "ProtectionEligibility",
+    "evaluate_policy",
+]

+_STOP_MARKET = "STOP_MARKET"
+_STOP_LIMIT = "STOP_LIMIT"
+_TRAIL_PRICE = "TRAIL_PRICE"
+_TRAIL_PERCENT = "TRAIL_PERCENT"
+_ALLOWED = "ALLOWED"
+_REJECTED = "REJECTED"
+
+_RISK_NOTES = (
+    "A stop trigger price is not a guaranteed execution price or maximum loss.",
+    "A stop-limit order may not fill.",
+    "DAY TIF expires and leaves an overnight residual unless protection is renewed.",
+)
+
+
+class ProtectionMode(StrEnum):
+    FIXED = "FIXED"
+    TRAILING_NATIVE = "TRAILING_NATIVE"
+    TRAILING_STEPPED = "TRAILING_STEPPED"

+def _positive_decimal(value: object, name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:

+    if not value.is_finite() or value <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite positive Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+def _order_semantics(value: object) -> str:
+    raw = value.value if isinstance(value, OrderType) else value
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        raise TypeError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
+    normalized = raw.strip().upper()
+    if normalized == OrderType.STOP.value:
+        normalized = _STOP_MARKET
+    if normalized not in {_STOP_MARKET, _STOP_LIMIT}:
+        raise ValueError("order_semantics must be STOP_MARKET or STOP_LIMIT")
+    return normalized
+
+

+    supported_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_tifs: frozenset[TimeInForce | str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_linked_order_types: frozenset[str | OrderType] = field(

+    linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(default_factory=frozenset)
+    paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters: frozenset[str] = field(

+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in (
+            "supported_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_order_types",
+            "fractional_combinations",
+            "paper_proven_fractional_combinations",
+            "supported_tifs",
+            "paper_proven_tifs",
+            "linked_order_types",
+            "paper_proven_linked_order_types",
+            "standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters",
+            "linked_trailing_parameters",
+            "paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters",

+            "paper_proven_order_types",
+            "linked_order_types",

+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        broker: _ProtectionBrokerPort,
+        clock: ClockPort,
+        policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+    ) -> None:
+        if broker is None:
+            raise TypeError("broker is required")
+        if not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must provide now()")
+        if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+        self._broker = broker
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._policy = policy
+        self._cycles: dict[str, _CycleState] = {}
+        self._unprotected_cycles: set[str] = set()
+
+    @property
+    def entry_block_reasons(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        """Fresh-entry blocks raised by any currently unprotected filled cycle."""
+
+        if not self._unprotected_cycles:
+            return ()
+        return ("UNPROTECTED_POSITION",)
+
+    def check_entry_eligibility(
+        self,
+        policy: ProtectionPolicy,
+        capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+        mode: ExecutionMode | object,
+        intended_qty: Decimal,
+    ) -> ProtectionEligibility:
+        """Evaluate protection before entry submission.
+
+        ``entry_allowed`` on the result is false precisely when required
+        protection is ineligible.  No strategy pause or holding-period input is
+        accepted by this safety boundary.
+        """
+
+        return evaluate_policy(policy, capabilities, mode, intended_qty)
+
+    async def on_confirmed_fill(
+        self,
+        cycle_id: str,
+        cumulative_filled_qty: Decimal,
+        avg_fill_price: Decimal,
+        *,
+        confirmed: bool = True,
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot | None:
+        """Cover a positive, broker-confirmed cumulative entry fill."""
+
+        cycle = _text(cycle_id, "cycle_id")
+        quantity = _decimal(cumulative_filled_qty, "cumulative_filled_qty")
+        price = _decimal(avg_fill_price, "avg_fill_price", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(confirmed, bool):
+            raise TypeError("confirmed must be bool")
+        if not confirmed or quantity == _ZERO:
+            return self.current_protection(cycle)
+
+        state = self._cycles.setdefault(cycle, _CycleState(cycle_id=cycle))
+        if quantity < state.confirmed_entry_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("cumulative_filled_qty must not decrease")
+        state.confirmed_entry_quantity = quantity
+        state.avg_fill_price = price
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+
+        if state.working_exit is not None or state.pending_exit_quantity > _ZERO:
+            return self._snapshot(state)
+        if state.protective_order_id is None:
+            await self._place_protection(state)
+        elif state.working_protective_quantity != state.remaining_quantity:
+            await self._request_replacement(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    async def on_exit_requested(
+        self, cycle_id: str, qty: Decimal, reason: str
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        """Queue or submit an exit without overlapping an effective stop."""
+
+        state = self._require_cycle(cycle_id)
+        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
+        exit_reason = _text(reason, "reason")
+        if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("cannot exit a cycle with no confirmed remaining position")
+        if state.working_exit is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("an exit order is already working for this cycle")
+        requested = state.pending_exit_quantity + quantity
+        if requested > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("requested exit quantity exceeds confirmed remaining quantity")
+
+        state.pending_exit_quantity = requested
+        state.pending_exit_reason = exit_reason
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            if state.status != "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_EXIT":
+                state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_EXIT"
+                await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)
+        else:
+            await self._release_pending_exit(state)
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    async def on_broker_order_update(
+        self,
+        cycle_id: str,
+        order_id: str,
+        status: object,
+        *,
+        filled_qty: Decimal = _ZERO,
+        avg_fill_price: Decimal | None = None,
+        occurred_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        """Apply a normalized cumulative broker-order update."""
+
+        state = self._require_cycle(cycle_id)
+        broker_order_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        normalized = _status(status)
+        cumulative = _decimal(filled_qty, "filled_qty")
+        if avg_fill_price is not None:
+            _decimal(avg_fill_price, "avg_fill_price", positive=True)
+        state.updated_at = self._now() if occurred_at is None else _utc(occurred_at, "occurred_at")
+
+        if broker_order_id == state.protective_order_id:
+            await self._apply_protective_update(state, normalized, cumulative)
+        elif state.working_exit is not None and broker_order_id == state.working_exit.order_id:
+            await self._apply_exit_update(state, normalized, cumulative)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("order update does not belong to an effective order for this cycle")
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+        return self._snapshot(state)
+
+    def current_protection(self, cycle_id: str) -> _ProtectionSnapshot | None:
+        state = self._cycles.get(_text(cycle_id, "cycle_id"))
+        return None if state is None else self._snapshot(state)
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        return _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock.now()")
+
+    def _require_cycle(self, cycle_id: str) -> _CycleState:
+        cycle = _text(cycle_id, "cycle_id")
+        try:
+            return self._cycles[cycle]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown PositionCycle id: {cycle}") from None
+
+    async def _broker_call(self, preferred: str, fallback: str, request: object) -> object:
+        method = getattr(self._broker, preferred, None)
+        if not callable(method):
+            method = getattr(self._broker, fallback, None)
+        if not callable(method):
+            raise TypeError(f"broker must provide {preferred}() or {fallback}()")
+        return await _await_if_needed(method(request))
+
+    async def _place_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        if state.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+            return
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("cannot place a second effective protective order")
+        if state.avg_fill_price is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("confirmed average fill price is required for protection")
+        request = _ProtectiveOrderRequest(
+            cycle_id=state.cycle_id,
+            quantity=state.remaining_quantity,
+            confirmed_avg_fill_price=state.avg_fill_price,
+            policy=self._policy,
+            created_at=self._now(),
+        )
+        try:
+            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call(
+                "submit_protective_order", "submit_order", request
+            )
+            state.protective_order_id = _order_id(acknowledgement)
+            state.protective_order_quantity = state.remaining_quantity
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            state.status = "PROTECTION_ACTIVE"
+            state.last_error = None
+            self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective placement failed: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)
+
+    async def _request_replacement(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        if state.protective_order_id is None:
+            await self._place_protection(state)
+            return
+        if state.status == "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT":
+            return
+        state.pending_replacement = True
+        state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT"
+        await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)
+
+    async def _cancel_effective_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        order_id = state.protective_order_id
+        if order_id is None:
+            return
+        cancel = getattr(self._broker, "cancel_order", None)
+        if not callable(cancel):
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, "broker must provide cancel_order()")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error)
+        try:
+            await _await_if_needed(cancel(order_id))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective cancellation failed: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+
+    async def _release_pending_exit(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        quantity = state.pending_exit_quantity
+        if quantity == _ZERO:
+            return
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("cannot release exit while protection remains effective")
+        if quantity > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise RuntimeError("pending exit exceeds confirmed remaining position")
+        reason = state.pending_exit_reason
+        assert reason is not None
+        request = _ExitOrderRequest(state.cycle_id, quantity, reason, self._now())
+        try:
+            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call("submit_exit_order", "submit_order", request)
+            state.working_exit = _WorkingExit(_order_id(acknowledgement), quantity)
+            state.pending_exit_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.pending_exit_reason = None
+            state.status = "EXIT_ACTIVE"
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"exit placement failed after protection cancel: {exc}")
+            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
+
+    async def _apply_protective_update(
+        self, state: _CycleState, status: str, cumulative_filled: Decimal
+    ) -> None:
+        if cumulative_filled < state.protective_cumulative_filled:
+            raise ValueError("protective cumulative filled quantity must not decrease")
+        if cumulative_filled > state.protective_order_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("protective filled quantity exceeds its order quantity")
+        state.protective_cumulative_filled = cumulative_filled
+
+        if status in {"PARTIALLY_FILLED", "PARTIAL_FILL"}:
+            state.status = "PROTECTION_PARTIALLY_FILLED"
+            return
+        if status == "FILLED":
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            state.status = "POSITION_CLOSED" if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO else "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+            if state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                self._mark_unprotected(state, "protective order filled without closing position")
+            else:
+                self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+            return
+        if status in {"CANCELED", "CANCELLED"}:
+            replace_after_cancel = state.pending_replacement
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            if state.pending_exit_quantity > _ZERO:
+                await self._release_pending_exit(state)
+            elif replace_after_cancel and state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                await self._place_protection(state)
+            elif state.remaining_quantity > _ZERO:
+                self._mark_unprotected(state, "protective order canceled without replacement")
+            return
+        if status in {"REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}:
+            state.protective_order_id = None
+            state.protective_order_quantity = _ZERO
+            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
+            state.pending_replacement = False
+            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective order became {status}")
+            return
+        if status not in _TERMINAL:
+            # ACCEPTED/PENDING/NEW updates preserve the currently effective order.
+            return
+
+    async def _apply_exit_update(
+        self, state: _CycleState, status: str, cumulative_filled: Decimal
+    ) -> None:
+        working = state.working_exit
+        assert working is not None
+        if cumulative_filled < working.cumulative_filled:
+            raise ValueError("exit cumulative filled quantity must not decrease")
+        if cumulative_filled > working.quantity:
+            raise ValueError("exit filled quantity exceeds its order quantity")
+        delta = cumulative_filled - working.cumulative_filled
+        working.cumulative_filled = cumulative_filled
+        state.confirmed_exit_quantity += delta
+
+        if status in {"PARTIALLY_FILLED", "PARTIAL_FILL"}:
+            state.status = "EXIT_PARTIALLY_FILLED"
+            return
+        if status in _TERMINAL:
+            state.working_exit = None
+            if state.remaining_quantity == _ZERO:
+                state.status = "POSITION_CLOSED"
+                self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
+            else:
+                await self._place_protection(state)
+
+    def _mark_unprotected(self, state: _CycleState, message: str) -> None:
+        state.status = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+        state.last_error = message
+        state.updated_at = self._now()
+        self._unprotected_cycles.add(state.cycle_id)
+
+    def _assert_sell_invariant(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
+        working = state.working_protective_quantity + state.working_exit_quantity
+        if working > state.remaining_quantity:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "working protective plus exit quantity exceeds confirmed remaining long quantity"
+            )
+        if state.protective_order_id is not None and state.working_exit is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("protective and discretionary sell orders must not overlap")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _snapshot(state: _CycleState) -> _ProtectionSnapshot:
+        return _ProtectionSnapshot(
+            cycle_id=state.cycle_id,
+            status=state.status,
+            confirmed_remaining_quantity=state.remaining_quantity,
+            protective_order_id=state.protective_order_id,
+            protective_working_quantity=state.working_protective_quantity,
+            exit_order_id=None if state.working_exit is None else state.working_exit.order_id,
+            exit_working_quantity=state.working_exit_quantity,
+            pending_replacement=state.pending_replacement,
+            pending_exit_quantity=state.pending_exit_quantity,
+            updated_at=state.updated_at,
+            last_error=state.last_error,
+        )
